name: blob
title: Blob
description: Flat organic SVG blobs that wobble and change shape as they move, melting into one shape through a goo filter where they meet. Lava lamp motion (heat at the bottom, rise, cool, sink) or a free drift; optional merging that joins blobs for good and splits big ones apart; circle, capsule or rect vessels; heat or per-blob tints with ready-made palettes; a liquid fill and a pointer blob that stirs and fuses with the rest.
